column2: agreed keep, but the lowercase common noun is 35 of 120 (29%), just under the one-third ruling, and the capitalised uses are the place Varano Borghi: keep or drop?
agreed merge:energético, but all 122 occurrences are capitalised 'Energéctica' and spread is low: likely a company name (drop) rather than a misspelling
agreed keep with no examples and only 2 of 96 lowercase: is the real noun (recruit) really a third of uses, or is it mostly a title or name?
agreed keep as a national Cuban cultural body (writers and artists union): household-name national body under the institutions ruling, or an ordinary organisation that drops?
agreed keep as Radio Habana Cuba, but it appears as a news-agency tag and in unrelated contexts (manuals); household-name broadcaster or a minor one that drops?
agreed drop as a fragment, but 57 of 121 are lowercase, likely the first half of the loan 'mise en place' / 'mise en scène': split-loan merge into the compound, or drop?
agreed keep; lowercase onomatopoeia is 30 of 95 (32%), borderline, and the dominant reading is the CLAC fair-trade acronym: keep or drop?
